name: voice-room
description: Simple link-based LiveKit voice chat with screen sharing.

scripts.dev:restart: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart livekit-gate api web
scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm --workspace @voice-room/site run build
scripts.build:app: npm --workspace @voice-room/web run build && npm --workspace @voice-room/admin run build && npm --workspace @voice-room/meet run build && npm --workspace @voice-room/widget run build
scripts.check: npm run check:app && npm run check:site && npm run format:check
scripts.check:app: npm --workspace @voice-room/shared run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/ui run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/call run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/api run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/web run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/meet run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/widget run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/admin run check && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-web-palette.mts && node scripts/check-web-styles.mts && node scripts/check-test-source-reads.mts --app && node scripts/check-type-coverage.mts --app && npm run lint -- --ignore-pattern "apps/site/**" && prettier --check apps/admin apps/api apps/meet apps/web apps/widget packages scripts --log-level warn --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier/
scripts.check:site: npm --workspace @voice-room/site run check && node scripts/check-test-source-reads.mts --site && node scripts/check-type-coverage.mts --site && eslint apps/site --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint-site/ && prettier --check apps/site --log-level warn --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/prettier/
scripts.test: npm --workspace @voice-room/shared run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/api run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/web run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/meet run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/widget run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/admin run test && npm run test:site && node --test scripts/test/*.test.mts
